number_change_why: A compliant fix adds currently unserved LOO ci_low and ci_high values to review.json and the page. Those are new served numbers under the task's definition. Existing primary estimates, primary CIs, trial counts, k, and LOO point estimates need not change.
fix: In _build_outcome, retain ci_low, ci_high and ci_provenance from each existing _pool_result call alongside dropped and estimate. Derive a separate inference classification relative to null=0 for MD/SMD and null=1 for ratios, comparing each omission with the primary interval; distinguish below-null, includes-null and above-null, and fail closed on missing intervals. Remove the unconditional 'no single trial drives it' note. Describe the point range separately from inference, naming omissions that change inference or stating that every LOO CI includes the null. In analysis_tab add a 'HKSJ 95% CI' column for every LOO row. In _loo_text show the inference summary alongside the point range and link to the complete Analysis table. Regenerate through the generators, preserving existing display/refusal gates. No estimator replacement is needed: synth.pool already computes PM/HKSJ using t(k−1) and max(1,Q/(k−1)).
plant: Add an integration regression named test_loo_intervals_and_inference_change, parametrized over the committed esketamine-trd-madrs and noac-vs-warfarin-af-stroke inputs. Rebuild their primary outcome through the production outcome builder using the committed protocol/source inputs, then render Analysis and Results. Independently construct Study objects from the admitted trial inputs and call _pool_result(studies[:j] + studies[j+1:], scale=scale) for each omission. Exact assertions: assert len(loo['per_trial']) == len(studies); for every row assert (row['estimate'], row['ci_low'], row['ci_high'], row['ci_provenance']) == (expected['estimate'], expected['ci_low'], expected['ci_high'], expected['ci_provenance']); assert all(row['ci_low'] <= null <= row['ci_high'] for row in loo['per_trial']); assert not (primary['ci_low'] <= null <= primary['ci_high']); assert each parsed LOO table row contains the matching dropped label, formatted estimate, and both formatted expected CI endpoints under a 'HKSJ 95% CI' header; assert 'Every LOO 95% CI includes the null; the primary CI excludes it.' appears in both LOO summaries; assert 'no single trial drives it' not in loo_text.lower() and 'robust' not in loo_text.lower().
